sources.name: Tournament decklists (Magic Online, Melee, Topdeck)
sources.note: Last 42 days, a list counting half as much for every 14 days since it was played. Magic Online: 94 tournaments, 1498 lists from Challenges and other events, 511 from leagues; Melee: 30 tournaments, 1867 lists from Challenges and other events, 0 from leagues; Topdeck: 1 tournaments, 10 lists from Challenges and other events, 0 from leagues. A league shows only its 5-0 lists, so one counts a third. Named with the rules of Badaro/MTGOFormatData. This is tournament play, mostly best of three, not the Arena ladder.
